Name: Laelia Glade
Author: 8BitAlien
Description:
[center]
﻿[/center]                                                                                          ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/oPIXM3p.jpeg[/img]

Laelia Glade is a beautiful location found North of the Backwoods. The Glade is a fantastic area to forage for goodies, and if you're lucky, you may find some rare forage! The waters here are a great place to find multiple types of fish and up that fishing skill of yours.

                                                              [img]https://i.imgur.com/TScWThK.png[/img]

Alice is a brand new NPC introduced with this mod. She is a fairy who hasn't yet gained her fairy wings. Alice appears confident and at times, full of herself, but is there more to her than originally meets the eye? Befriend Alice and she may open up to you! Gifting Alice any Red Mushrooms you find around the Valley is a great idea, as she will always return the favour by gifting you something as thanks. Who knows what item she could gift you?

                                                                                                [img]https://i.imgur.com/0hoNfsY.png[/img]
NEW UPDATE!! Laelia Glade now has a secret hidden area to the North containing lots of goodies. Someone unknown is living in the cottage nearby and kindly leaves out a freshly cooked meal each day for the Farmer. Who could this be?

                                                                                          Compatible with both SVE and base game
                                                                                                                1.6 compatible
                                                           (I have some more updates planned for Laelia Glade when I have fewer commitments!)
